title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass | Matte Black | Freestanding Toilet Paper Holders | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when you don’t have wall space for a mounted holder in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. This freestanding toilet paper stand brings a decorative, transitional look to the bathroom while staying secure on the floor.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Keep the stand stable — sturdy base prevents tipping
  • Maintain a coordinated look — color-coordinated solid brass tissue roller
  • Ideal for small baths and guest bathrooms — adds function without drilling

Specs & Installation

  • Overall dimensions: 5.5 in L x 26 in H x 6 in W
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Shipping weight: 6 lbs
  • Assembled in the U.S.A.
  • Collection: Freestanding Toilet Paper Holders
  • Multiple designer finish options available
